questions_and_answers.question_text: कहा जाता है कि शांति स्थापित करने का प्रबंध किया जायेगा ।

answers.answer_text: It is said that arrangements will be made to establish peace.

answers.answer_text: An atmosphere of friendship will be created among nations.

questions_and_answers.question_text: विद्यार्थियों से अपील की गई है कि पढ़ाई पर अधिक ध्यान दें ।

answers.answer_text: An appeal has been made to students to pay more attention to their studies.

questions_and_answers.question_text: यदि प्रबंध जल्दी न किया गया तो अराजकता फैलने का डर है ।

answers.answer_text: If arrangements are not made soon there is a fear of anarchy spreading.

questions_and_answers.question_text: पिछले वर्ष बहुत लोगों को सुरक्षित स्थानों पर ले जाया गया था ।

answers.answer_text: Last year many people were taken to safe places.
